notes.title: Bring the mayhem: Bullet Runner's Demo Out NOW & full release in November!
notes.content:
Here we go then, Bullet Runner is ready, and you better get ready to rumble!

On November 14, 2024, Bullet Runner is coming out on PC, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. The game is ready, it's beautifully boomer, it's a shooter that'll keep your blood pressure climbing higher and higher.

Bullet Runner is a boomer shooter. Twin-stick shooter. Shooter. Full 10 hours of explosive action with baddies - massive armies of enemies swarming all over you and your mission is a simple one: destroy them all.

Check out our brand-new trailer to dive into the story and world of Bullet Runner:

[previewyoutube=o4REgRj1SpA;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll have an arsenal of weapons, like shotguns, pistols, snipers, bazookas... And your fists. When your ammo and health are out, beat and kick the living .... out of your enemies and you're going again. Oh, and there's special moves and of course epic parkour to make it all more difficult. 

We'll promise you this: we did not make this an too easy of an game for you.

Too tired of waiting any more? We just released a demo for you to get going! Get your demo here and start honing your skills:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899850/Bullet_Runner_Demo/

notes.title: FEATURE REVEAL #1
notes.content:
Based on feedback from players, we have added more parkour into the game. Parkouring adds a new level of excitement and immersion to the game. Many players have enjoyed the fluidity and speed of the parkour moves, as well as the ability to seamlessly combine them with shooting and combat.

Parkour sections encourage exploration and experimentation, as they can be used to discover hidden areas and shortcuts throughout the game.


[previewyoutube=EWgHY0IJ9W0;full][/previewyoutube]

Bullet Runner has similar parkour mechanics to Doom Eternal. Normally people love or hate this. But I assure you that parkouring in Bullet Runner is really fun.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628292/df16787aa8ccc3d84c55fb3f935e8c17b6ff2a1e.jpg[/img]
[i]We hope you like parkour sections[/i]

Stay tuned for more feature reveals in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Bullet Runner: The Prologue Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]If you know what The BFG is, then this game is made for you
[/h1]
[i]Bullet Runner is Doom-esque top-down shooter coming in late 2023 but releasing a 4-hour free prologue version out already in November 2022. Load your BFG and get in the game![/i]

Bullet Runner is like pure adrenaline poured into your brain and veins, just like the good ol’ days with Doom and Quake. You are Jack, and for some reason everyone wants you dead. Buller Runner is a top-down shooter where you run your way through the enemy-filled facility shooting, blasting, and raging through any obstacle set in your way.

[i]“My love for DOOM Eternal is very strong, and I wanted to create my own kind of homage to the Doom series. Fighting and especially the glory kill mechanisms will be familiar for all like minded players, but in Bullet Runner the main character is just a regular badass-Jack''[/i] tells Laura Moon, the developer behind the game.

[previewyoutube=GXS0Vzm3XcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is set to be released in late 2023 with well over 10 hours of gameplay, but the developer prepared a special free prologue to be released already in November 2022. The prologue will feature a lot of game to play – it will take about 3—4 hours for an average player to slay through the game. It is clear this prologue is not a demo, but a full game with specifically designed levels.

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Action-packed top-down shooter with free 4-hour prologue out in November 2022
[*] Lots of guns and items, glory-kills, missions to solve, enemies to slay, and smooth movement extras like rail slides, running on barrels, and chain swings
[*] Prologue out until the 31st of December, with updated and new features hinted during the period
[/list]
 
Bullet Runner on Steam (Prologue opening on Tue, November 22nd 2022 as a Steam Playtest): [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/[/url]

Trailer on YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GXS0Vzm3XcQ]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GXS0Vzm3XcQ[/url]

notes.title: Bullet Runner - Demo V1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We hope you're all doing good. We've just released an update for the Bullet Runner demo build. This update includes a range of visual and performance improvements, as well as new game-feel additions and polishing.

[previewyoutube=_KIjOZ-uQwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try, and let us know what you think!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3Sc8dQqHr5]Join our Discord![/url]

[b]Changes/Additions[/b]

- Added level intro sequences
- Modified level starting areas
- Greatly reduced chance of player catchphrases
- Tweaks, changes and improvements to game menu's
- Moved weapon-reel to the top-right of the screen
- Added option to set weapon-reel to either center or top-right of the screen
- Recoded the entire chain system (it's a LOT more reliable and snappier now)
- Zoomed out the gameplay camera for better visibility in arena fights
- Slightly improved the game's performance
- Added lighting colorization effects to 3D sprites

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]
We hope you had a great Christmas and new years! 

We’ve been hard at work, working on a very big new update that you’ll all get to experience very soon!


One of the big visual changes we’ve been working on is to increase the height of the walls in the levels, as well as improve the look of the lower front walls. This will assist in making it feel like the player is [b]‘inside’[/b] of a building, and help with environmental immersion.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628292/5334b5cedfff29184f750b3acd8b0a5f80ba4264.png[/img]


Next to environmental improvements, we’ve been hard at work adding in new enemy-types, polishing up existing mechanics and improving / reworking existing levels. 
Without going into too much detail (more will be revealed very soon), have a look at this video showcasing some [b]raw uncut gameplay[/b] from the build we’re currently working on!! :


[previewyoutube=_xWNSnEVI9A;full][/previewyoutube]


Thank you all for reading this devlog, and we hope to see you next time with more Bullet Runner news!

Join to Discord : https://discord.gg/yZDTcmtKVP


Thank you all, and take good care.
Best.
